name: mcp-hyperspace-memory

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: Store a new memory, event, fact, or procedure for the agent in collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129'. Automatically vectorizes text and stores with session_id, tags, memory_type (semantic, episodic, procedural), and importance (1-10). Returns a JSON object with memory_id, status, and metadata summary.

session_id.description: Session or conversation identifier. Scopes recall to a specific conversation.

memory_type.description: Type of memory: 'semantic' (facts, preferences), 'episodic' (events, context), 'procedural' (instructions, rules). Default: 'episodic'.

importance.description: Importance level from 1 (minor detail) to 10 (critical core fact). Default: 5.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Retrieve the most relevant memories for a query from collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129' using semantic similarity. Filter by session_id, memory_type ('semantic'|'episodic'|'procedural'), or min_importance (1-10). Returns a JSON object with query, filters, and ranked memories with cognitive scores.

query.description: What to search for in memory.

session_id.description: Optional: filter results to a specific session identifier.

min_importance.description: Optional: filter memories with importance >= min_importance (1-10).

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete a specific memory by numeric memory_id from collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129'. Returns a JSON object with success status and confirmation message.

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: Update an existing memory by deleting memory_id and storing new_text with refreshed embeddings and metadata. Returns a JSON object with old_memory_id, new_memory_id, and status.

memory_id.description: ID of the memory to replace.

session_id.description: Session identifier (keep the same as the original if updating in place).

tags.description: Updated tags for the new memory.

tools.name: memory_list_sessions
tools.description: Discover unique session_ids and active conversation threads present in collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129'. Uses multi-probe vector queries to ensure comprehensive session discovery. Returns a JSON object with session_count and list of sessions with memory counts and recent sample previews.

limit.description: Max number of candidate memories to scan across domain probes (default: 100).

tools.name: memory_explore_hierarchy
tools.description: Explore conceptual hierarchy in memory using Lorentz Cone Subsumption. 'up' navigates to parent/hypernym concepts; 'down' returns the subsumption tree of descendant concepts. Returns a JSON structure of the hierarchy.

concept_id.description: The memory/concept ID to start from.

direction.description: 'up' → broader parent concepts. 'down' → specific descendant concepts.

tools.name: memory_consolidate
tools.description: Consolidate a cluster of related episodic memories into a single abstract semantic concept using the Fréchet Mean on the hyperboloid. Optionally stores the synthesized summary_text back into memory (persist: true) and cleans up source memories (archive_sources: true). Returns a JSON report with consolidated_id, mean vector, and source IDs.

topic_query.description: A topic or query to identify the cluster of memories to consolidate.

summary_text.description: Optional: synthesized summary or abstract statement representing the consolidated concept.

persist.description: Whether to store the consolidated concept into memory (default: true).

archive_sources.description: Whether to delete/purge the source episodic memories after consolidation (default: false).

tools.name: memory_verify_claim
tools.description: Verify whether a logical claim (conclusion) is geometrically consistent with a premise in 129D MRL hybrid space (Lorentz + Cosine). Returns a JSON object with status ('VERIFIED'|'REJECTED'), trust_score (0.0-1.0), geodesic distances, and geometric explanation to prevent hallucinations.

conclusion.description: The claim to verify against the premise.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Get operational statistics and health diagnostics for the memory collection 'agent_cognitive_memories_129'. Returns a JSON object with total vector count, dimension, metric, cascade settings, and host information.
